rules.label: Rolling Return
rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan consistently outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 1.00% (14.73% vs 13.73%).
Only 44.9% of rolling windows beat the benchmark — weak relative consistency.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.77 vs 0.68) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 2.20% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.46).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-37.57% vs -37.92%).
Rolling return range spans -4.31% to 29.97% (34.28 pp spread) — consistency score 67.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
